notes: Seeded from IPTC Media Topics, adapted to the Newvelles corpus (US-leaning general news, 2021-2026). Every story gets exactly one major and one sub. 'other-*' subs are the escape valve; a healthy classification puts <8% of stories there. v1.1 adds boundary_rules only — no category changes; existing v1.0 labels remain valid.

Politics & government.elections: Campaigns, primaries, election nights, results, voting logistics
Politics & government.white-house: The president, the administration, executive orders, cabinet
Politics & government.congress: House/Senate action, bills, hearings, shutdown fights, confirmations
Politics & government.courts-law: Supreme Court and appellate rulings, judicial nominations, legal doctrine
Politics & government.policy-regulation: Agency rules, public policy debates, regulation and deregulation
Politics & government.state-local-politics: Governors, mayors, state legislatures, ballot measures
Politics & government.other-politics: Political stories fitting no sub above

Conflict & security.war: Interstate war and large-scale armed conflict, invasions, offensives, ceasefires
Conflict & security.military-defense: Armed forces, weapons programs, defense budgets, exercises
Conflict & security.diplomacy-geopolitics: Summits, treaties, sanctions, alliances, international tension short of war
Conflict & security.other-conflict: Security stories fitting no sub above

Crime & justice.trials-courts: Criminal and civil trials, verdicts, sentencing, high-profile litigation
Crime & justice.policing: Police conduct, arrests, investigations, law enforcement policy
Crime & justice.fraud-corruption: Fraud, corruption, white-collar crime, scandals with legal exposure
Crime & justice.immigration-enforcement: Border enforcement, deportation, immigration courts and policy
Crime & justice.other-crime: Crime stories fitting no sub above

Economy & work.job-market: Employment, layoffs, hiring, wages, labor data
Economy & work.inflation-prices: Inflation, cost of living, prices of goods and services
Economy & work.housing: Housing market, rents, mortgages, real estate, homelessness
Economy & work.trade-supply-chain: Tariffs, trade deals, imports/exports, supply chains
Economy & work.corporate: Company news: earnings, leadership, strategy, layoff announcements framed as company events
Economy & work.other-economy: Economic stories fitting no sub above

Markets & finance.banking-finance: Banks, credit, interest rates as market events, financial stability
Markets & finance.personal-finance: Consumer money advice, retirement, taxes for individuals
Markets & finance.other-markets: Market stories fitting no sub above

Tech.ai: Artificial intelligence: models, companies, policy, adoption
Tech.big-tech: Platform companies: product, antitrust, moderation, corporate moves
Tech.social-media: Social networks as story subject, creator economy, online culture
Tech.other-tech: Tech stories fitting no sub above

Science & space.research: Scientific findings and studies outside health
Science & space.other-science: Science stories fitting no sub above

Health.pandemic-outbreaks: COVID and other infectious-disease waves, vaccines in outbreak context
Health.public-health-policy: Health systems, insurance, health agencies and policy
Health.other-health: Health stories fitting no sub above

Climate & environment.extreme-weather: Storms, heat waves, floods, weather events as news
Climate & environment.disasters-accidents: Earthquakes, wildfires as events, crashes, industrial accidents
Climate & environment.energy: Oil and gas, renewables, power grid, energy prices as sector news
Climate & environment.other-environment: Environment stories fitting no sub above

Sports.olympics: Olympic games and olympic sports in games context
Sports.other-sports: All other sports: tennis, golf, hockey, combat, motorsport, college

Culture & entertainment.movies: Film industry, releases, box office, awards
Culture & entertainment.tv-streaming: Television and streaming shows and platforms
Culture & entertainment.celebrities: Celebrity news not centered on a work: relationships, deaths, controversies
Culture & entertainment.media-industry: News media, publishing, journalism as subject
Culture & entertainment.arts-books: Books, visual arts, theater, cultural institutions
Culture & entertainment.other-culture: Cultural stories fitting no sub above

Everyday life.shopping-deals: Product roundups, sales, deals, consumer picks
Everyday life.human-interest: Feature stories about people, animals, oddities, viral moments
Everyday life.obituaries: Deaths of notable people as the story
Everyday life.other-everyday: Everyday stories fitting no sub above

US news (general).local-incidents: Local news events without a clearer category: fires, closures, community
US news (general).other-general: Stories that resist every other category

meta_tags.definition: 2-6 lowercase tags per story. Two kinds: (1) salient named entities from the title (people, orgs, places, events); (2) group keywords more granular than the sub-category that cluster related stories even when the word is absent from the title (e.g. 'trial', 'world cup', 'immigration crisis', 'layoffs', 'ceasefire', 'recall').
meta_tags.style: lowercase, singular where natural, multi-word allowed, no hashtags, no duplicates of the sub-category name

boundary_rules: Product deals, promo codes, discount roundups, and betting promos always classify as Everyday life/shopping-deals, regardless of the product's domain (tech, sports, finance).
Consumer advice and how-to content classifies by its advice function (personal-finance, lifestyle-wellness), not by the topic it advises about (fraud, health).
Deaths under active investigation classify as Crime & justice, not local-incidents, until ruled accidental.
Classify the story's subject, not its vehicle: a newsletter about campus politics is education, not media-industry.
